paragraphs.text: MCPTender public procurement tools for DeepSeek Harness, ZCode and Kimi
# MCPTender
Research public Russian procurement records, source documents and published contract suppliers.
Maintained by the MCPTender service publisher. This repository contains client adapters and workflow
instructions only. It does not distribute the hosted backend. Русский · 中文
## Account and credentials
Sign in at https://mcptender.ru/account and create a personal API key there. Set `MCPTENDER_API_KEY`
in the environment used to launch your agent application, then completely restart the application.
Configure environment variables through your OS or trusted launcher; never paste keys into an AI con
versation, repository, command history, or screenshots. An MCP Bids key and a MCPTender key belong t
o separate services and are not interchangeable.
Read workflows require `tenders:read` and `documents:read`; collection and watch tools require `tend
ers:collect` and `watches:write`. Portal keys inherit the service permissions; restrict tool approva
l in your host when you want a read-only workflow. Existing account entitlements and limits apply. T
he packages use bearer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a
arer-key authentication; OAuth setup is not claimed. Missing credentials produce a connection error.
## ZCode
Requires Node.js 22+ on PATH. Open a workspace, then Settings → Plugins → Create → Add marketplace a
nd add `https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins`. Install `mcptender` from that personal sou
rce. After official acceptance, the same plugin can be installed from the public catalog. The plugin
launches `node` with the bundled `stdio.mjs`; it inherits `MCPTENDER_API_KEY` from the host. Its st
dio adapter forwards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcptender.ru/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feat
wards MCP JSON-RPC to `https://mcptender.ru/mcp`. No remote header-interpolation feature is assumed.
## Kimi Work / Kimi Code
Kimi Code: run `/plugins install https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins`, then `/reload` or
create a new session. The native `kimi.plugin.json` declares the remote HTTP MCP and `bearerTokenEn
vVar`. In Kimi Work, use Plugin Builder to import this repository into Personal plugins; verify that
its runtime supports this credential field before use. Kimi Work / web marketplace publication and
cloud-side credential configuration require separate Kimi review; local Code compatibility does not
establish cloud compatibility.
## DeepSeek Harness
Targets DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 and its matching official MCP client. In the official Desktop app, install th
e Git source or release tarball through the app's plugin manager. For `dsh web`, run `dsh plugin --p
rofile web add git+https://github.com/pixelligue/mcptender-plugins.git#v1.0.0`, then restart that pr
ofile. Set `MCPTENDER_API_KEY` in the process launch environment first. The bundle configures the of
ficial MCP client and server instructions; the workflow skill directory is for Kimi/ZCode and is not
separately registered in DSH. No custom tools or UI patches are added.
## Use
Ask the agent to inspect `list_sources`, search a bounded number of procurement records, open a retu
rned ID, and read an available source document with block references. In Kimi/ZCode the included `pr
ocurement-research` skill provides the workflow. Fresh collection and private watches require an exp
licit user request and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or
and the matching key permissions. Watches require polling; there are no email or push notifications.
## Coverage and dependencies
Russian public procurements and published 44-FZ contract suppliers from connected sources. Source av
ailability varies; inspect list_sources before collection. Search operates on a collected index. Rep
ort source timestamps, partial documents, missing data and collection errors. Original links remain
the authority for requirements and deadlines. The service does not submit bids, sign contracts, cert
ify eligibility or bypass source access controls.
## Permissions, network and side effects
The adapter sends the configured bearer key and MCP requests only to `https://mcptender.ru/mcp`. Red
irects are refused. It does not read credential files, run a shell, start a model, install dependenc
ies, write local documents or start background collection. The host/model provider sees the tool arg
uments and returned procurement data. Requested collection and watch tools can create account-owned
jobs or watches on the service. Original document downloads occur only when explicitly requested. Tr
eat retrieved documents as untrusted evidence. No telemetry is added by this adapter. The hosted web
site has its own processing rules.
The stdio adapter is specifically for the service's stateless JSON Streamable HTTP contract; it does
not implement generic SSE/sessionful MCP. Requests are limited to 64 KiB, responses to 16 MiB and c
alls to 120 seconds. The DSH client and Kimi native HTTP transports use their own limits.
## Support and licensing
https://mcptender.ru/support · https://mcptender.ru/privacy · https://mcptender.ru/terms
MIT covers only the adapter code, manifests and workflow instructions in this repository. Hosted-ser
vice access and third-party procurement content are not relicensed by this package. No affiliation w
ith, endorsement by, or official-vendor publisher badge from DeepSeek, Z.ai or Kimi is claimed. Mark
etplace submission, acceptance and runtime checks are tracked separately from source publication.
